content: "The Ax-4 mission, which reached the ISS on June 26, was led by Peggy Whitson, a former NASA veteran, and piloted by Group Captain Shukla. The crew comprised Slawosz Uznanski-Wisniewski from Poland and Tibor Kapu from Hungary."
"Only the second Indian to travel to space, Group Captain Shukla's journey occurred 41 years after cosmonaut Rakesh Sharma's flight on a Russian Soyuz in 1984."
"Group Captain Shukla, who was born in the northern city of Lucknow on October 10, 1985, began his career in the air force as a fighter pilot in 2006."
